verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an authentication framework/library, not an AI agent or assistant that itself consumes tools from external MCP servers. Its MCP-related features documented in evidence are server-side: it lets an app act as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients (docs-12) and hosts its own remote MCP server exposing documentation (docs-18/32/43), neither of which is the client role of 'plugging in MCP servers so this product can use their tools'.
